measurement_this_round.why_it_matters: the scored rerun drives bm.solver.concurrency = 120 over ~110 private games while the launcher configures the server with --max-running-requests 10 (MAMBA_CACHE 60). At most 10 of 110 games can hold a decode slot at any instant, and 13 of 25 public games could not complete a single action inside their entire 240 s budget. Decode on an INT4 hybrid is weight-read-bound, so batch is the one lever this configuration leaves unspent -- and it is measurable for free in the same smoke.
